name: Hehehe Game
summary:
Hehehe game is...

- 10 unique levels: sell crates just for the sake of crates, and then participate in cart-racing (and all of this in a single level).
- Two narrators: who will constantly mock you (no hard feelings).
- Total absurdity: inspired by The Stanley Parable and all kinds of memes.
- Perfect for streaming: tons of unexpected twists (WW cargo bringers).

This is the second installment of the game. The first part was released only on itch io and was not registered on IGDB
